name: Pilates studio

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Reformer Flow class
services.story: The main story: a reformer in Nadia's $55 Reformer Flow class, Sat 11:00am (8 reformers), paid in full when booking. Alex is new, so the waiver and health questions are on the secure page.

services.name: Mat class
services.story: A $35 Mat class, or a class from Alex's pack. A card is saved for the studio's $20 late-cancel or no-show fee. Anything owed is paid at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Private session at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 private session at Alex's home with Leo, who brings a portable reformer. A card is saved and charged $179 when Leo texts DONE.

services.name: Mat class at an office
services.story: A $150 mat class at an office, for up to 12 people, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Private session at home
services.story: A $179 private session at home, for a client Sam bills after. Nothing is taken when booking. Rosie texts the bill after the session.

services.name: Team Pilates event
services.story: A team Pilates event at an office, priced from photos of the room at $640. Sam OKs it. A $160 deposit now, and the rest on the bill after.

services_shape: class: a reformer (or a mat or tower) in a set class time; each machine is one spot, so a class never takes more people than machines; a waitlist; each person booked is checked in on their own. Private and duet sessions book one instructor, at the studio, a home or an office
questions_before_times: new to the studio, or been before (sets any intro offer, the waiver and the health questions)
the class (reformer, mat, tower, prenatal) or a private or duet session
reformer experience: none, some, or a year or more
for the teen class: the client's age
for a session away from the studio: home or office, how many people, and mat or a portable reformer
safety_stop: someone unwell right now: chest pain, fainting, trouble breathing, or pregnant with bleeding or strong pain
license: from the state form: teaching Pilates usually needs no state license; massage needs one where the state's rules require it; some places register fitness studios or health clubs
staff_skills: reformer, mat, tower, prenatal, teens, post-rehab; only instructors cleared for prenatal work teach prenatal classes or read prenatal notes
messages_never: health answers and notes, injuries, pregnancy, conditions, doctor's notes and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI, to the client, the owner or the staff: texts say only 'a health note' with a secure link
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
